intro: A product designer whose resume reads like a short portfolio: each role names the problem, the design work, and what changed for users.
tips: Link your portfolio in the first lines; the resume points to it.
Describe research and testing, not only screens.
Show outcomes from your designs: completion, satisfaction, support load.

basics.name: Amélie Laurent
basics.label: Product Designer
basics.summary: Product designer with six years in fintech and health. Redesigned a loan application that cut drop-off by a third, and built the design system three squads ship with.

work.name: Crédit Clair
highlights: Redesigned the loan application after 25 usability sessions; drop-off fell by 34%.
Built the design system (Figma and React) used by 3 squads and 20 engineers.
Ran monthly research sessions with customers that set the product team's quarterly priorities.

work.name: Santé Plus
highlights: Designed appointment booking used by 80,000 patients a month.
Worked with clinicians to simplify the symptom checker; support calls about it fell by half.
